mapper.select: /* 방 헤더 조회: 제목/방장/방장닉네임 - 멤버 목록은 RoomMemberMapper에서 재사용하여 가져온다 */ SELECT r.quiz_room_id AS quizRoomId, r.room_title AS roomTitle, r.room_owner AS ownerId, u.user_nickname AS ownerNickname FROM tb_quiz_room r JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = r.room_owner WHERE r.quiz_room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_quiz_room WHERE is_private = 'N' AND room_status = 'W'

SELECT quiz_room_id AS quizRoomId, room_title AS roomTitle, joined_count AS joinedCount, room_capacity AS roomCapacity FROM tb_quiz_room WHERE room_status = 'W' AND joined_count < room_capacity ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.quiz_room_id AS roomId, (SELECT c.current_quiz_index FROM tb_quiz_current_index c WHERE c.quiz_room_id = r.quiz_room_id) AS currentIndex, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_room_member m WHERE m.quiz_room_id = r.quiz_room_id) AS totalMembers, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m2.is_ready='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tb_room_member m2 WHERE m2.quiz_room_id = r.quiz_room_id) AS readyCount, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.is_corrected='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tb_room_member m3 LEFT JOIN tb_room_user_log l ON l.room_member_id = m3.room_member_id WHERE m3.quiz_room_id = r.quiz_room_id) AS correctCount FROM tb_quiz_room r WHERE r.quiz_room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, -- ✅ userNickname 필요 SUM(CASE WHEN l.is_corrected='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount, qr.room_quiz_limit AS total FROM tb_room_member m INNER JOIN tb_user u ON m.member_id = u.user_id -- ✅ user 테이블 조인 INNER JOIN tb_quiz_room qr ON m.quiz_room_id = qr.quiz_room_id LEFT JOIN tb_room_user_log l ON l.room_member_id = m.room_member_id WHERE m.quiz_room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_nickname, qr.room_quiz_limit ORDER BY correctCount DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
